identityTest.stableIdentity: Each asserted outcome and benefit or disbenefit remains identifiable across forecast revisions, delayed observations, partial realization, attribution adjudication and reversal.
identityTest.versionIdentity: Changes to expected effect, realization window, value method, attribution, evidence or status create immutable revisions or lifecycle events while preserving the outcome or benefit identity.

observation value and measurement execution mastership

invariants: Objective, metric, target, deliverable, outcome and benefit retain distinct identities.
Targets pin exact metric-definition revisions and a metric change never silently changes a target or baseline.
Deliverable completion never proves an outcome or benefit realization.
Realization requires qualified observations whose phenomenon time falls inside the declared realization window.
Expected and realised claims coexist and realised values never overwrite forecast history.
Missing measurement carries an explicit absent reason and is never represented as zero.
Attribution claims state contributor, period, share, method, evidence and uncertainty where applicable.
Adjudicated attribution shares for one benefit and period cannot exceed one.
Programme and constituent-project contribution claims cannot double count the same contribution and period.
Disbenefit is negative polarity of the same aggregate and is never netted against benefit without an explicit commensuration method.
Units, scale versions, methods, phenomenon time, result time and uncertainty travel with every value.
Retired and superseded identifiers remain resolvable and are never recycled.
